people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hiram
people.line: King of Tyre, ally of David and Solomon.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”
translations.bsb: When Hiram received Solomon’s message, he rejoiced greatly and said, “Blessed be the LORD this day! He has given David a wise son over this great people!”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be Jehovah this day, who hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
